pli-tv-bi-vb-pc85:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc85:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo yānena yāyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc85:1.1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo yānena yāyissanti seyyathāpi gihiniyo kāmabhoginiyoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc85:1.1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc85:1.1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo apupicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc85:1.1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo yānena yāyissantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc85:1.1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo yānena yāyantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc85:1.1.11: hi nāma bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo yānena yāyissanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc85:1.1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc85:1.1.14.1: yā pana bhikkhunī yānena yāyeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc85:1.1.15: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhunīnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc85:1.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī gilānā hoti na sakkoti padasā gantuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc85:1.2.4: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc85:1.2.5.1: yā pana bhikkhunī agilānā yānena yāyeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc85:2.1.10: vayhaṃ ratho sakaṭaṃ sandamānikā sivikā pāṭaṅkī.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc85:2.2.1: agilānā agilānasaññā yānena yāyati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc85:2.2.2: agilānā vematikā yānena yāyati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc85:2.2.3: agilānā gilānasaññā yānena yāyati āpatti pācittiyassa.
